definitions.gloss: joining a club, entering a school club
definitions.explanation: Becoming a member of a club activity (部活動) at school, typically in middle school or high school. A fundamental part of Japanese school life.

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{入部|にゅうぶ}{届|とどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit a club membership form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ったら→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I can't decide which club to join when I start middle school.

notes:
Specifically refers to school club activities (⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧). In Japanese schools, students typically choose a club to join at the start of the school year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入部|にゅうぶ}{届|とどけ} (club membership application form)
- {入部|にゅうぶ}⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ (desire to join a club)
- {入部|にゅうぶ}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (tryout for joining a club)
- ～⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入部|にゅうぶ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (join the ~ club)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退部|たいぶ}→退部：21010_taibu⟧: quitting a club

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入会|にゅうかい}→入会：11671_nyuukai⟧: joining an organization (broader — gyms, associations, etc.)
- ⟦{入団|にゅうだん}→入団：11972_nyuudan⟧: joining a team or troupe (sports teams, theater groups)
